name: quality-gate-definition
description: Define quality gates in the delivery pipeline: per-stage gates (commit / build / merge / deploy / release), objective pass/fail criteria, automation where possible, manual approval where needed (who, when, what's approved), escape-hatch + waiver process, sprint exit criteria, review process for PRs / design / security. Distinct from DoR/DoD (team agreement) — gates are enforceable pipeline checkpoints. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
